# Exact software versions (COBIDAS reproducibility)
# All versions verified from dataset_description.json files, run logs,
# and direct environment queries (python3 --version, MATLAB version).

## Environments
Preprocessing environment : Neurodesk (cloud, containerised; GitHub-authenticated)
Analysis environment      : Local workstation (macOS)

## Preprocessing (Neurodesk)
fMRIPrep (Study 1 primary) : 21.0.2  (public derivatives distributed with ds002748)
fMRIPrep (Study 1 v25)     : 25.2.5  (--fs-no-reconall; executed as preprocessing-sensitivity branch)
fMRIPrep (Study 2)         : 25.2.5  (ds003007)
Python                     : 3.13.14 (Neurodesk)
nilearn                    : 0.14.0
nibabel                    : 5.4.2

## Analysis (local, MATLAB)
MATLAB                     : R2026a (26.1.0.3276743, Update 3)
GIFT                       : gift-master (trendscenter), MOO-ICAR
NeuroMark 2.2              : fMRI 2.2, 105 networks, modelorder-multi.
                             PRIMARY network identification (Studies 1 and 2).
NeuroMark 1.0              : fMRI 1.0 (Neuromark_fMRI_1.0.nii).
                             Network-definition SENSITIVITY branch (Study 2 posterior/whole/anterior DMN).
SPM                        : SPM12 (template reslicing only)
NBS toolbox                : 1.2

# Notes
# - Data-driven ICA branch (Study 1 sensitivity): GIFT Infomax + ICASSO, 20 components.
# - Triple-network component indices (NeuroMark 2.2): ECN 91-93, DMN 94-101, salience 102-105.
# - Preprocessing (fMRIPrep + nilearn denoising) ran on Neurodesk; all MATLAB
#   analysis (network definition, FNC, NBS, TOST) ran locally on the workstation.
# - Study 1 primary used the public fMRIPrep 21.0.2 derivatives (not re-run from raw);
#   Study 2 and the Study 1 v25 sensitivity branch used fMRIPrep 25.2.5.
